Complete AI Hackathon

Build Every Aspect of Your AI Product with Collaborative AI Agents

Teams work together with multiple AI Agents in shared workspaces to design, build, and launch complete AI products — from initial idea to market-ready app.


📅 February 23– March 1, 2026

⏱️ 6 days to build and ship an end-to-end agentic AI product

🤝 Work together in shared AI workspaces where your team and AI Agents collaborate in real time

🔧 Build with multiple AI Agents that handle development, design, testing, and documentation together

🎯 Create everything in one place — from ideation to product to marketing materials, all by prompting and observing

🚀 Focus on real-world products that teams could actually ship and use

🏆 $3,500 in prizes + premium 3-month Complete.dev access for top teams

🧑‍💻 Join your team workspace and start building together Teams work together

About

Complete.dev is where teams build products together with AI Agents inside shared workspaces. Instead of isolated chats, Complete brings agents, files, history, and team collaboration into one environment so you can design, build, test, document, and market products in a single flow.

The Challenge for this hackathon is to build an AI application that uses at least 2 AI Agents working together, plus create all your marketing materials — everything in one shared workspace. Complete gives your team the tools to create everything from ideation to final product by simply prompting and observing the AI Agents work together.


This is a team-first hackathon focused on real workflows, clear user experience, and products that could realistically ship. Work together with AI Agents that understand your shared context and build on each other's work, just like your team does.

Challenge
Challenge

Build an end-to-end AI product using Complete.dev's collaborative workspace

Your challenge is to design and prototype a production-minded AI application powered by at least two collaborating AI Agents that you create during the hackathon.

Think like a product team, not just a demo builder.


Your Challenge Requirements


• Create at least 2 custom AI Agents using the Agent Builder to power your application's core functionality
• Connect your custom agents to your app as the main product experience 

• Build end-to-end from concept to working prototype with marketing materials 

• Collaborate in shared workspace where all agents, files, and team work stay connected


Required deliverables


Your team must submit a complete product package built entirely within Complete.dev:


• Working product prototype - A ready-to-use application powered by your custom AI Agents

• Go-to-market strategy - Complete positioning and launch plan

• Pitch deck - Professional presentation of your product and vision

• Marketing website (optional) - Coded within Complete to demonstrate real-world product positioning 


All product development and marketing assets must be built entirely within Complete.dev to showcase the platform’s full capabilities.

The percentage of Complete.dev usage will be a key evaluation criterion alongside product quality, agent collaboration, UX, and real-world applicability.

➡️ Final project submissions will be uploaded and evaluated on the lablab.ai platform.

Technology


To build your project, you will use Complete.dev as the core and required platform for all product development and marketing deliverables.


This hackathon is designed to test and showcase end-to-end agentic product building inside a single collaborative AI environment.


🔒 Core Technology (Required)

  • Complete.dev is a collaborative AI platform where teams build products together with AI Agents inside shared workspaces. It enables:

    • • Multi-agent collaboration across coding, testing, documentation, and research

    • • Persistent workspace memory and shared context

    • • Parallel use of multiple AI models

    • • Governance and visibility across agent actions

    • • End-to-end workflows from product development to go-to-market assets


    All submitted projects must be built primarily and demonstrably inside Complete.dev. The depth and percentage of platform usage will be considered during evaluation.


  • 🔓 Platform Access

    • Approved participants will receive free access and usage credits for Complete.dev throughout the hackathon period.


      This ensures all teams can fully explore the platform’s capabilities, including agent collaboration, shared workspaces, and marketing agents, without worrying about usage limits during the event.


      No paid subscription is required to participate or submit a project during the hackathon.

      Team workspaces will be upgraded to Premium once verified by the Complete team

      What You'll Have Access To

      Your team workspace comes with pre-made specialist agents ready to help: 

      • Code Agent - handles development and implementation 

      • Agent Builder - your main tool for creating new custom AI Agents

      • Architect - designs system architecture and technical decisions 

      • Product Agent - guides product strategy and user experience 

      • Strategy Agent - develops go-to-market and positioning

      • Copywriter - creates all written content and messaging 


    🚀     How to Get Started

Before the hackathon begins, we recommend that all participants:

  • • Create a Complete.dev account using the same email you used to sign up on lablab

  • • One team leader should create the Complete.dev workspace for the team and invite all teammates.
    • Only one workspace per team should be created.
    • Explore the platform interface and agent capabilities

  • • Familiarize yourself with shared workspaces and agent coordination

This will help you move faster once the hacking period starts.
All participants must use the same email on lablab and on Complete.dev.

To help you get started and build effectively:

What to submit?

Your team must submit a complete product package built primarily in Complete.dev. Submissions should reflect a production-minded AI application powered by at least two custom AI Agents that you create during the hackathon.

📋 Basic Information

• Project Title

• Short Description

• Long Description

• Technology & Category Tags

💻 App Hosting & Code Repository

• Demo Application Platform

• Application URL

📸 Marketing & Presentation Materials

• Cover Image

• Video Presentation

• Slide Presentation / Pitch Deck 
• Marketing Website (optional)

For further details and guidance, please visit Submission Guidelines


Note:
The marketing website is optional but highly encouraged. It should be built within Complete.dev to showcase your product’s features, brand, and go-to-market strategy. Even a simple, polished site highlighting your app’s value proposition can make your submission stand out.

⚠️ Submissions that are not primarily built in Complete.dev may be disqualified.

Submission Terms & IP

By participating in this hackathon:

    • • Participants retain ownership of their submissions.

    • • Participants grant the sponsor an exclusive, perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify, commercialize, and create derivative works from submitted projects.

    • • All projects must use public or self-owned data only.

    • • Organizers may feature submitted projects on Complete.dev, lablab.ai, and partner channels for promotional purposes.

    Participation requires agreement to these terms during registration.


Judging Criteria
Application of Technology
How effectively the chosen model(s) are integrated into the solution.
Presentation
The clarity and effectiveness of the project presentation.
Business Value
The impact and practical value, considering how well it fits into business areas.
Originality
The uniqueness & creativity of the solution, highlighting approaches and ability to demonstrate  behaviors.

Hackathon Details

Join lablab.ai hackathon and innovate using the latest models in the market. Discover all the relevant details below.

🗓️ Where and when

The hackathon will take place Feb 23– March 1. 2026. The hackathon will take place on the lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord server.

🦸🏼‍♂️ Who can join?

We welcome participants with a strong interest in AI. While prior experience can be helpful, this challenge is designed for those ready to engage with AI in meaningful and practical ways.

😅 What about teams?

If you don't have a team, don't worry! You can connect with other participants from all over the world on our dashboard or Discord server. We also recommend checking out our Discord server to find teammates and bounce around ideas. You can join the server here.

🛠️ How to participate

The hackathon will take place online on lablab.ai platform and lablab.ai Discord Server. Please register for both in order to participate. To participate click the "Sign up" button at the bottom of the page and read our Hackathon Guidelines and Getting Started Guide.

🧠 Get prepared / Use Lablab.ai to Learn About AI

To get ready for the hackathon, visit our AI Tech pages and read up on all the available technologies. You can also check out our tutorials page for more information on how to use them. Get a head start on your project by using the resources on lablab.ai!
